additional_notions: KSGT — Recovered Theory Ancestors & Live Rival Ecology

goal: Produce Korean writing that is more contextually natural, factually faithful, rhythmically appropriate and purpose-fitting than a preregistered general-purpose model baseline; not fool an AI detector or maximize scarcity of visible patterns.

historical_syntax_inventory.name: UNLICENSED_ANTITHESIS
historical_syntax_inventory.hypothesized_failure: Introduce an unasserted strawman A or imply false exclusivity
historical_syntax_inventory.measure: discourse-supported relation and reader inference, not regex count

historical_syntax_inventory.name: TRANSLATIONESE_FUNCTIONAL_VERB
historical_syntax_inventory.hypothesized_failure: Unmotivated calque/abstract predicate displaces concrete event descriptions
historical_syntax_inventory.legitimate_use: Technical writing where function/role is literal and appropriate

historical_syntax_inventory.name: EVALUATIVE_FLATTERY_AND_META
historical_syntax_inventory.measure: unsupported evaluative utterance rates with pragmatic context

historical_syntax_inventory.name: THREE_PART_PARALLEL_TEMPLATE
surface: A는 B를 보여준다. 또한 C는 D를 강화한다. 이러한 E는 F에 기여한다.
historical_syntax_inventory.hypothesized_failure: Sentence skeleton recurrence unrelated to information hierarchy
historical_syntax_inventory.legitimate_use: Deliberate parallelism for argument contrast, emphasis, poetry
historical_syntax_inventory.measure: syntactic skeleton repetitions, information novelty and reader cadence

historical_syntax_inventory.name: SENTENCE_AND_PARAGRAPH_CADENCE
historical_syntax_inventory.measure: sentence span distribution, clause structure, ending alternation, information-flow arrangement

historical_syntax_inventory.name: UNJUSTIFIED_DISCOURSE_CONNECTIVES
historical_syntax_inventory.hypothesized_failure: Connective licenses a causal/contrastive/inferential relation not actually present
historical_syntax_inventory.measure: annotated discourse relation truth conditions and causal support

historical_syntax_inventory.name: NOMINALIZED_ABSTRACTION
historical_syntax_inventory.hypothesized_failure: Excessive abstraction loses events, actors and evidence
historical_syntax_inventory.measure: proposition grounding and explicit event reference

historical_syntax_inventory.name: INFORMATION_STRUCTURE
historical_syntax_inventory.hypothesized_failure: A single subject particle or clause order used without observed discourse state
historical_syntax_inventory.legitimate_use: Multiple licensed realizations under given preceding discourse
historical_syntax_inventory.measure: context-conditioned felicity, contrast inference and referent tracking

historical_syntax_inventory.name: VOICE_AND_RELATIONSHIP
historical_syntax_inventory.hypothesized_failure: Register and stance drifting without audience/genre justification
historical_syntax_inventory.legitimate_use: Context-grounded social stance and narrative perspective

historical_syntax_inventory.name: ELLIPSIS_REPETITION_LEXICAL_TEXTURE
historical_syntax_inventory.hypothesized_failure: Overexplicitness or unnatural synonym substitution flattens Korean cohesive style
historical_syntax_inventory.legitimate_use: Referentially recoverable ellipsis, meaningful emphasis, genre-specific texture

research_design.primary_object: A passage-level Korean writing decision, with documented intent, actual information, audience, genre and discourse state.
research_design.test_material: Construct two task banks: authored short controlled linguistic contrasts, then licensed Korean factual/essay prompts with verifiable source packets. Human written reference or edits only under informed lawful collection.
arms: B: frozen general-purpose AI baseline, no hidden quality feedback
K: KSGT-informed writer using context/meaning/discourse/rhythm variables, not simple lexical blacklist
A: targeted anti-template ablation only, to test whether surface bans explain perceived naturalness
research_design.primary_comparison: Blind randomized reader pairwise preference for idiomatic, purpose-fitting Korean with factual faithfulness checked separately. No model self-scoring as human gold.
anti_shortcut: Avoid teaching model to mimic typos, randomness or 'human' imperfection
Do not use AI detector evasion as quality metric
Do not penalize grammatical or rhetorical constructions solely because AI also uses them
Evaluate paragraph-level coherence, not only sentence-level edits
Do not optimize weights on the heldout reader panel
research_design.control_plan: Same prompt/source facts and token/length range; preregister baseline model version and decoding; isolate semantic changes from style changes; no prompt leakage between arms.
research_design.separation: Historical P50 24 PIA corpus is reused diagnostic and cannot be called fresh; the writing study needs different newly authored or licensed essays with heldout subjects and prompts.
research_design.analysis: Paired reader preference with uncertainty and task-level estimates; preserve ties and dissensus, no single scalar quality verdict. Check genre interactions and hard factual errors.
research_design.minimum_viable_pilot: Two distinct genres × three documents × three arms = 18 drafts; blinded readers judge pairs, then new heldout bank for replication. This is a design target, not collected data.
research_design.stop_rule: Every stage must contribute a concrete Korean realization contrast, a bounded written passage sample, or new reader observation; no more than one infrastructure-only stage without return to writing.

adjacent_existing_measurement: 6-context 12-trial topic/focus pilot remains one narrow part of the larger syntax ecology, not a surrogate for holistic natural writing.
